sermon.title: The Holy Spirit in the Old and New 10/22/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that the unchanging God’s Holy Spirit worked in the Old Testament as in the New: he spoke through the prophets, filled the tabernacle builders, gave David the temple pattern, cleanses by judgment and burning, and fills with power. Now poured on all flesh, he gives tongues as a sign to unbelievers, calls and sends ministers, and moves in God’s seasons—so the church must learn to hear him and recognize the times.
